📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-10
1. Turkey Expands Presidential Office's Power to Control the Internet, Can Order Platforms to Block Content Within 2 Hours政策
土耳其擴大總統府網路管制權，可要求平臺2小時內執行封鎖
Turkey enacted Law No. 7590 on July 31, centralizing internet oversight power within the presidential office. In emergencies, the government can order telecom firms, ISPs, data centers and content platforms to block content, with compliance required within two hours before judicial review follows.
土耳其在7月31日正式實施第7590號法律，將部分網路管制權集中至總統府。遇到緊急情況時，政府可下令電信業者、網路服務商、資料中心及內容平臺採取封鎖等管制措施，業者最遲須在收到命令後2小時內執行，之後才由法院審查。

2. AI Agent Security Startup Obsidian Security Raises $85M, Valued at $1.1B產業
AI代理安全業者Obsidian Security募資8,500萬美元，估值達11億美元
As enterprises rapidly adopt AI agents, concerns over permissions and data access risks are growing. Obsidian Security, which focuses on non-human identity and AI agent security, closed an $85M Series D round at a $1.1B valuation to expand R&D and enterprise reach.
AI代理快速進入企業應用，也讓權限與資料存取風險受到更多關注。專注於第三方應用程式非人類身分與AI代理安全的業者Obsidian Security宣布完成8,500萬美元D輪募資，公司估值達11億美元，資金將用於強化AI代理安全研發並拓展大型企業市場。

3. OpenAI Acquires AI Presentation Startup NextSlide產業
OpenAI併購AI簡報生成平臺新創業者NextSlide
NextSlide, a US-based startup that turns prompts, notes or documents into polished, editable presentations, announced it has been acquired by OpenAI and will integrate its features into ChatGPT.
AI簡報生成平臺業者NextSlide宣布已被OpenAI收購，將把其功能整合進ChatGPT。這家成立僅一年多的新創公司，讓使用者輸入提示或上傳文件即可生成精美、可編輯的簡報檔。

4. Levi's Employee Computers Hacked, Company Data Stolen資安
Levi's遭駭入員工電腦，竊走公司資料
Levi Strauss & Co. disclosed that attackers used social engineering to access three employees' computers and steal internal company files, though it said customer personal data was not affected, according to its SEC filing.
服飾品牌Levi's近日發生員工電腦遭駭，攻擊者利用社交工程手法存取三名員工的公司電腦並竊走公司檔案。該公司向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交報告指出，消費者個資未受影響。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Cloudflare Unveils Agent-First AI Browser Kitesurf, Touts Lower Compute and Memory Use產品
Cloudflare公布代理人優先的AI瀏覽器Kitesurf，強調更省運算資源、記憶體
Cloudflare last week introduced Kitesurf, a stateless browser designed specifically for AI agents, running in isolated V8 Worker environments and claiming to use far less CPU and memory than Chromium.
Cloudflare上周公布專為AI代理人執行而設計的無狀態瀏覽器Kitesurf，將搭配隔離環境V8 Worker執行，強調比Chromium更節省CPU資源與記憶體。

6. Microsoft Open-Sources Cross-Language Unit Test Agent, Internal Tests Show 92.1% Completion Rate, Beating Native Copilot模型
微軟開源跨語言單元測試代理，內部評測完成率92.1%高於原生Copilot
Microsoft's .NET team open-sourced a cross-language unit testing agent that first analyzes a project's language, tools and existing test patterns before generating and checking unit tests. In internal testing across 152 tasks, it completed 140 (92.1%), outperforming native GitHub Copilot's 78.9% using the same model and prompts.
微軟.NET團隊開源一套跨語言單元測試代理，可先了解專案使用的程式語言、測試工具及既有測試方式，再自動產生並檢查單元測試。微軟內部以152項任務測試，該代理完成140項，完成率92.1%，高於使用相同AI模型與提示內容的原生GitHub Copilot（78.9%）。

7. Embattled Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Invests $400M in Chip Startup Source Foundry產業
陷入爭議的對沖基金Situational Awareness投資4億美元於晶片新創Source Foundry
The AI-focused hedge fund is still making big bets, pouring $400 million into chip startup Source Foundry despite its own recent troubles.
這家專注AI領域的對沖基金儘管近期陷入爭議，仍持續進行大手筆投資，將4億美元投入晶片新創公司Source Foundry。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
8. Anthropic Is Turning Claude Code's Auto Mode On by Default產品
Anthropic將把Claude Code的自動模式設為預設開啟
Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight, as Anthropic makes auto mode the default setting for the coding tool.
使用Claude Code進行程式開發未來將需要更少的人工監督，Anthropic宣布將把自動模式設為這款程式開發工具的預設選項。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
9. The AI Safety Test Is Becoming a Safety Risk資安
AI安全測試本身正成為一種安全風險
AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems, raising questions about whether safety infrastructure, industry standards and regulation can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.
AI代理正逐漸逃脫資安測試環境並觸及真實系統，這引發外界質疑安全基礎設施、產業標準與法規是否能跟上日益強大的模型發展速度。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. AI Detectors Are Creating a New Era of Distrust研究
AI偵測工具正在製造新一波的不信任
As AI-generated text becomes harder to distinguish from human writing, detection tools meant to restore trust are instead fueling widespread suspicion and false accusations.
隨著AI生成文字越來越難與人類寫作區分，原本用來重建信任的偵測工具，反而引發了廣泛的懷疑與錯誤指控。
